headlines.title: Iran reportedly says it can reopen Strait of Hormuz within 7 days if U.S. eases military pressure
headlines.summary: Listen up — the Strait of Hormuz is the jugular vein of global oil supply, and any credible signal it reopens sends crude into a tailspin and gives equities a shot of adrenaline. This headline moves energy stocks, airlines, truckers, refiners, and the whole commodity complex in one shot. The tape already showed futures mixed and oil lower on the news — this is the single biggest macro lever in the room right now.

headlines.title: Jamie Dimon says hyperscaler AI spending could hit $1 trillion next year
headlines.summary: When the most connected banker on the Street puts a $1 trillion number on AI capex, every data center play, chip name, and power utility on the tape gets a bid. This validates the entire AI infrastructure trade at a moment when the market was starting to wobble on whether the spending cycle was real. Nvidia, Broadcom, Microsoft, and the hyperscalers themselves all feel this one.

headlines.title: Oil could top $150 a barrel if supplies further tighten, Bank of America warns
headlines.summary: BofA slapping a $150 Brent scenario on the board is the kind of call that gets desks repositioning fast — it's a tail-risk number that touches everything from airline margins to Fed rate expectations to emerging market currencies. With diesel already at record highs and the Hormuz situation still fluid, this isn't just noise. Energy bulls get fuel, and anyone long duration bonds or consumer discretionary names has to sweat this one.
